title: Exceptional experience...
text: Exceptional experience with amazing scenery and guide.  The cable car and funicular added a fun touch along with the hike to see some of the mountain.
author: Jeff_W

title: Amazing afternoon in Monserrat
text: Our half day private tour of Montserrat far exceeded our expectations.  I would rate “Barcelona Day Tours” 5 plus stars in every category.  Our driver Martha was amazing and made our experience perfect.  I would highly recommend this tour and company.
author: marilynsK9799WP

title: Mont Serrât Monastery, half day trip.
text: We had a great half day trip with Liana who picked us up at our Barcelona Hotel. The drive’s geography was jaw droppingly gorgeous. We learned about the Benedictine history and its current presence. We also had a dive into the recurrent symbolism and themes that cascade down through the varied cultural & religious histories of humanity. We hope to come back to this beautiful place.
author: Daydream56154239975
